At start, one question per blocked gate names the gate plainly, explains the exact refusal and recommends a choice. Clerical gate A recommends a substance check, disclosing lost platform enforcement unless it becomes a required status. Gate B offers written owner-approved tooling scoped to one action, with maintenance cost. Human approval gate C recommends keeping approval, with substance evidence. No refused permission is self-granted. Repeated instances reuse these decisions; reopening requires changed gates or permissions. No setting or new gate changed.
